fields.summary_ko.0: UBS raised AMZN target price from $318 to $348, implying 40% upside. AWS margin improvement is expected to offset concerns about massive AI capital expenditure.
fields.summary_ko.1: UBS projects 2027 AWS operating margin at 46%, compared to Wall Street consensus of approximately 38%, an 8 percentage point difference. Q2 AWS revenue of $42.2 billion achieved the highest growth rate of 37% among the past 18 quarters.
fields.summary_ko.2: 2027 capital expenditure may exceed $300 billion, but AWS custom chips and expanded AI services can support margin growth.
